questions.q: Why can't most enterprises just abandon on-prem Active Directory and move straight to a cloud-only identity?
options: Cloud identity services do not support user accounts
Active Directory is required by law to run alongside any cloud service
Years of user accounts, groups, and Group Policy are tied to it, and every on-prem app would break immediately
On-prem Active Directory cannot be removed from a Windows Server once installed
questions.explain: On-prem AD typically holds years of accumulated user accounts, groups, policies, and app dependencies — replacing it overnight would break the business.

options: An identity that only works for file servers, never cloud apps
One identity, originating in on-prem AD, that is also recognized by cloud identity services
A cloud-only identity with no connection to on-prem AD
Two completely separate accounts, one on-prem and one in the cloud, with different passwords
questions.explain: Hybrid identity means the same identity, not two disconnected ones, works across both on-prem and cloud.

questions.q: In a typical hybrid identity setup, which directory remains the "source of truth" where accounts are actually created and managed?
options: On-premises Active Directory
Entra ID exclusively
AWS IAM Identity Center
Neither — both directories create accounts independently
questions.explain: In most hybrid deployments, on-prem AD remains the source of truth, and a copy of its objects is synchronized to Entra ID.

questions.q: Without hybrid identity, what typically happens to an employee when a company adopts Microsoft 365 for the first time?
options: Their on-prem account would be deleted automatically
Microsoft 365 would refuse to create an account at all
They'd likely end up with two separate logins and passwords, with no connection between them
They would automatically get single sign-on with their existing AD account
questions.explain: Without a sync mechanism, IT would have to manually create a separate cloud-only account disconnected from the on-prem one.

questions.q: What's the general name for the mechanism that keeps on-prem AD and Entra ID consistent with each other?
options: Password hash sync only
Federation only
Directory synchronization
IAM Identity Center
questions.explain: Directory synchronization is the general term; Lesson 2 covers the specific tool, Microsoft Entra Connect.
